### What Is the "Bad Eye" in Matthew 6:23?
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/what-is-the-bad-eye-in-matthew-6-23
Passage: Matthew 6:22-23
Points:
- Jesus places the metaphor of the eye between sayings about heavenly treasure and serving money.
- Comparing this phrase to Matthew 20:15 shows that a "bad eye" reflects stinginess and blindness to God's grace.
- A bad eye covets material wealth rather than delighting in divine generosity.
- A healthy eye recognizes heavenly treasure in Christ as infinitely more precious than earthly riches.
- Focusing on worldly gain causes spiritual deception, leading people to serve money in deep darkness.
- Believers must pray for God to heal their spiritual sight so they value Christ above all earthly possessions.
